records.chat_source_excerpt: The completed body defines words as constrained routes that select, compress, store and transfer portions of reality. Central keeper: reality exceeds every word used to name it, while words still decide what becomes transferable, arguable, memorable, enforceable, executable and recoverable. The completion receipt marks the internal working model complete while explicitly withholding universal proof or accreditation.
records.boundary: This is a completed internal theory body with an explicit completion boundary. It may upgrade source custody and body status, but it does not become universal proof.

records.title: Past-Visit Present-Return Law
records.chat_source_excerpt: You go back to the past to visit, learn, recover and carry forward — not to live through it again. Correct return creates past → present → future and present → past-contact → returned-present → propelled-present. Attempting to live inside the past produces a diminished present and a mal-uppumped past. Keeper: visit the past, learn from it and carry it; do not re-live inside it.
records.boundary: This recovers the formed v0.1 route-law and its native wording. It does not claim that every return to the past is beneficial or that the route has completed external validation.

records.title: Pressure Point Finder / Pressure Point Provider
records.chat_source_excerpt: Pressure Point Finder detects where route-force gathers. Pressure Point Provider applies, removes, redirects or stabilises force at the correct point. The source separates too much, too little, misplaced, hidden, false, useful, transforming and dangerous pressure, then asks: where is the point that changes the route? Keeper: pressure is not the enemy; misplaced pressure is.
records.boundary: This is a source-backed role/body and operating law. It must not be inflated into a claim that every pressure point or correct intervention is already known.
